title: FIFA unveils Women's World Cup 2027 trophy in Rio de Janeiro
summary: FIFA unveiled the 2027 Women's World Cup trophy on Thursday (November 12) at a ceremony in Rio de Janeiro attended by former Brazilian players Aline Pellegrino and Pretinha.
